# MilePost Zero: Josie - Brahmin Tamer

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Sep 18, 2024
- 3 min read

Updated: Jan 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8e7d450f36ae473c93513af76d53a35e~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __SugarBombsRADS__

__Name__

Josie

__Role__

Brahmin Tamer

__Location__

After being hired: From Marley’s desk, face north and walk straight ahead. Stop at the stairs on your left. Josie will be standing next to the stairs, in front of the Brahmin shed.

__Cost__

Hire Cost (Tier 1) - 100 Supplies

Upgrade 1 (Tier 2) - 200 Supplies

Upgrade 2 (Tier 3) - 300 Supplies - **Cut from Live Servers**

__Notes__

After upgrading Josie to Tier 2 through Marley, be sure to go through all of Josie's dialogue options. Once you’ve completed all conversations and given her an Addictol, the Tier 3 Brahmin Buffs will unlock automatically. The plan for Josie's Snow Globe will become available once she’s off the chems. You may need to leave the server or exit and re-enter the tunnel to finish the dialogue and unlock the plan.

__Snow Globe__

Yes

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5948632b5f77419187b88d4e9976c881~mv2.jpg)

__Daily Quest__

No

__Vendor__

No

__Inventory__

Brahmin Buffs

These buffs only need to be bought once, are permanent, and stack with the other Brahmin buffs but do not stack on themselves.

If you’re new, low-level, or not ready for heavy combat, the constant enemy attacks on the caravan can make it difficult to keep the Brahmin alive. Consider investing some time and Supplies into buffing your Brahmin first. This will make farming the event and earning supplies easier in the long run.

For experienced and combat-ready players who want to complete the grind as fast as possible, or upgrade multiple vendors efficiently, spending 200 Supplies to hire Josie and purchasing the Cattle Encourager Brahmin Buff (tier 1) is a wise choice. This buff increases the speed of your Brahmin, cutting the event time from 10 minutes to 5 minutes or less.

__Tier 1__

**Wasteland Hay (Improved Health 01)** 

**Buff**

Fortify Health: +50 HP

Fortify Rad Health Max: +50 Rad Resist

**Cost**

25 Supplies

**Rad-free Alfalfa (Improved Health 02)**

**Buff**

Fortify Health: +70 HP

Fortify Rad Health Max: +70 Rad Resist

**Cost**

70 Supplies

**Cattle Encourager (Move Speed Increase 01*)**

**Buff**

Fortify Speed Mult: 5

Current speed x5 = Faster general speed

**Cost**

100 Supplies

**Note**

If you plan to run more than 10 Caravan Events, I highly recommend getting this buff.

__Tier 2__

**Thorn Feed (Reflects Damage 01)**

**Buff**

5% chance to Ricochet non-grenade damage

**Cost**

100 Supplies

**Irradiated Corn (Improved Health 03)**

**Buff**

Fortify Health: +100 HP

Fortify Rad Health Max: +100 Rad Resist

**Cost**

150 Supplies

**Cattle Inspirer (Improved Hurry Speed 01*)**

**Buff**

Fortify Hurry Length: +0.05 Seconds

*Hurry Speed lasts longer

**Cost**

250 Supplies

**Note**

While this makes the Brahmin faster again, the pace can be uncomfortable to maintain. It stops and starts frequently, and it's starting to use up my AP for chasing the Brahmin instead of saving it for V.A.T.S.

__Tier 3__

**Pre-War Vitamins (Improved Health 04)**

**Buff**

Fortify Health: +100 HP

Fortify Rad Health Max: +100 Rad Resist

**Cost**

250 Supplies

**Enhanced Thorn Feed (Reflects Damage 02)**

**Buff**

10% chance to Ricochet non-grenade damage

**Cost**

300 Supplies

**Endurance Crop (Health Regeneration 01)**

**Buff**

Restore Health: +10 HP every time the Brahmin takes damage.

Cooldown: 30 seconds

**Cost**

500 Supplies

**Note**

You can use the Friendly Fire perk card or the Legendary Prefix Medics to heal the Brahmin instead.

**Cattle Spurer (Improved Hurry Speed 02*)**

**Buff**

Fortify Hurry Length: +0.08 Seconds

*Hurry Speed lasts longer and stacks with Cattle Inspirer (Improved Hurry Speed 01)

**Cost**

500 Supplies

**Note**

While this makes the Brahmin faster again, the pace can be uncomfortable to maintain. It stops and starts frequently, and it's starting to use up my AP for chasing the Brahmin instead of saving it for V.A.T.S.
